values.note: Daily $40 a night, electric included, for 2 adults and 2 children; weekly $240; monthly (2+ months) $400 plus metered electric. Cash or check only, no credit cards. The page carries 'Copyright © 2024' and no other date.

fees.source: https://farmpondcampground.com/rates ('Daily-Electric include - $40/nite', 'Weekly- Electric included $240/week', 'Monthly(2+ months) - Metered electric additional $400/mo', 'Cash or checks accepted'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 'For reservations call Lisa at 910-947-5593 or 910-690-3817.' One family per campsite.

hookups.source: https://farmpondcampground.com/ ('Our initial sites have a rural neighborhood atmosphere, with full hook-ups'), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://farmpondcampground.com/rules ('There are no public showers or restrooms at this time, so only campers equipped with these facilities should stay') + https://farmpondcampground.com/ ('upgraded our sites with free WiFi'), read 2026-10-22

note: Small campground with a swimming and catch-and-release fishing pond on Union Church Rd near Carthage (Moore Co), north of Southern Pines and Pinehurst. Only campers with their own toilet and shower should stay (no public restrooms). Google 4.5 over 37 reviews. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $40/night with electric (weekly $240, monthly $400 + metered electric; page dated only by its 2024 copyright), full hookups, free WiFi, reservations by phone. Added: no public showers or restrooms (self-contained campers only). Not stated: amperage, site count, season. Note trimmed of the price and RV Life line the fields hold.
flags: Long-stay check (for a human): the park markets 'daily, weekly and monthly rates', 'an easy commute to Fort Bragg and near the best Moore County schools, for those wanting an extended stay with their families', and has monthly-camper policies (winter water-line insulation, monthly rent). It posts a nightly rate (test 2 passes), but the share of sites sold nightly is not published (test 4 unknown).
Rate date: the only date on the operator's pages is 'Copyright © 2024'. Cash or check only.
Phones: the operator lists office (910) 947-5593 (matches) and cell (910) 690-3817.
